patch_list: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Unlocks the AIMTS test series, the PYQ generator, video lectures and tier 1 and 2 questions in every topic. Tier 3 questions and flashcards are not included.
